requested_support: Apéry recurrence; Bell/Fubini EGFs; Euler up/down EGF and even/odd secant/tangent indexing. One additional leaf supports the actual partition-product lesson.
source_authentication: Every re-read full entry hash equals its previously authenticated metadata-record hash at the same pinned commit. No new broad search was performed.

records.normalization: A(n)=Σ_{k=0}^n binom(n,k)^2 binom(n+k,k)^2 (the ζ(3) Apéry sequence). Coefficients, index and seeds match exactly.
records.range: Recurrence n≥1; defining binomial sum n≥0.
records.source_status: stated in the OEIS formula field; no universal proof is supplied or independently audited here
records.application_check: The displayed project formula matches the source after only notation translation.

source_leaves.exact_field_excerpt: %F A000364 E.g.f.: Sum_{n >= 0} a(n) * x^(2*n) / (2*n)! = sec(x). - _Michael Somos_, Aug 15 2007

records.normalization: S(k)=OEIS A000364(k), nonnegative secant numbers. These are the even-index derivatives of sec, not coefficients weighted by k!.
records.range: k≥0, formal power series over Q.
records.source_status: stated in the OEIS formula field; no universal proof is supplied or independently audited here
records.application_check: The EGF is stated in the source. The equality to the indicated even/odd A000111 subsequence follows by coefficient uniqueness, because sec(z) is even and tan(z) is odd.

records.normalization: A000182 has OEIS offset 1. A zero-based tangent stream T(k)=A000182(k+1) uses odd factorial weights (2k+1)!.
records.range: k≥0, equivalently OEIS n≥1, formal power series over Q.
records.source_status: stated in the OEIS formula field; no universal proof is supplied or independently audited here
records.application_check: The EGF is stated in the source. The equality to the indicated even/odd A000111 subsequence follows by coefficient uniqueness, because sec(z) is even and tan(z) is odd.

source_leaves.exact_field_excerpt: %F A000041 G.f.: Product_{k>0} 1/(1-x^k) [remainder of field omitted]

records.normalization: p(0)=1. This is an ordinary generating function. Its formal degree-N prefix depends only on factors j≤N.
records.range: n≥0, formal power series over Z.
records.source_status: stated in the OEIS formula field; no universal proof is supplied or independently audited here

records.inclusion_reason: The author confirmed that the partition lesson uses this product, and does not display Euler’s pentagonal recurrence.

coefficient_translation: An EGF identity Σ a(n)z^n/n! is not an OGF identity Σ a(n)z^n. Polyphase operations on the integer numeric stream and on the factorial-weighted coefficient stream must be distinguished.
source_status_boundary: These OEIS fields state the known identities. This report authenticates the statement and exact normalization, and does not claim a universal proof certificate. Bounded exact computations are separate corroboration.
pentagonal_recurrence: not a dependency: the author confirmed it is not displayed
